sources.title: Planning Inspectorate statistical release 23 April 2026
sources.verified_claim: The April 2026 release reports March median decision times including 16 weeks for planning cases and 75 weeks for enforcement decisions, with published volumes. National medians cannot predict the duration or outcome of an individual sample-parcel case.

sources.title: Planning appeals: procedural guide - for appeals relating to applications dated on or after 1 April 2026
sources.verified_claim: The procedural guide reflects the 2026 written-representations changes and requires most appeals to use the Appeal a Planning Decision service. Procedure does not imply that a sample parcel has an appeal or that one would succeed.

sources.title: Appeals
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: National guidance sets appeal rights, deadlines, costs principles and performance targets. Target times are not guarantees and appeal rights do not establish a sample parcel's planning outcome.

sources.title: Enforcement appeals coming to the Appeal a planning decision service
sources.verified_claim: PINS announced phased digital enforcement-appeal rollout and identified Havering as one of three trial LPAs. Participation in the service trial is process evidence only and does not imply an enforcement issue at parcel_46142.

sources.title: Enforcement appeals: procedural guide
sources.verified_claim: The enforcement procedural guide was updated in April 2026 to clarify online-only submission and expanded grounds-of-appeal information. Procedural availability is not evidence that any candidate parcel is subject to enforcement.

sources.title: Planning Inspectorate Annual Report and Accounts 2025/26
sources.verified_claim: PINS reports around three in ten appeals allowed historically, around 23,000 homes permitted on appeal in 2025/26 and migration to the new digital service. Aggregate allowed rates must not be used as a probability for a sample parcel.

sources.title: Planning appeals
sources.verified_claim: Enfield explains rights of appeal after refusal, conditions or non-determination and directs appellants to the Planning Inspectorate. The existence of an appeal route is not evidence that parcel_30762 has an appeal or planning defect.

sources.title: Planning enforcement appeals
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth explains statutory enforcement appeal rights and notes such processes can often take up to a year. Local process guidance does not establish an enforcement notice or appeal at parcel_61522.
